name: Family function
source: The recorded second-visit story, on its sample person V04. testdata/eval/ground-truth.json V04 (the miss list), which is also what the shipped judge lines read out of testdata/clef/judge-V04-family-function.json; the biggest issue is that recording's own choice. The pick and the runner-up are testdata/api/look.json's fix and runner_up, the contract's recorded example of this story; this pair is named from that fixture, not from the lowest-read-flag rule the other three stories state. The render is the earring flow's recorded result (testdata/youcam/earring-fetch.json, results/earring-jhumka-V04.jpg), the genuine YouCam output of V04 with the fix's own gold-jhumkas reference. The check this story shows its render on is the recording named in the check below, testdata/clef/check-clef-V04-to-V05.json, and the pairing is stated rather than implied, because the two pictures are not the same file: that recording read this sample's own selfie as the original and woman/V05-family-function.jpg as the render it checked, so the picture its answers are about is that V05 render and not the earring result shown here, and what it was asked, in its own words, is 'Adds gold jhumkas and paints the lip red.' - that recording's own two-part ask, wider than this story's one declared change. It was asked about this fix's own criterion, ran on the check model the settings ship, and its three gate readings are this story's three facts at the shipped check lines. Its two look answers are the same two ways the fix's declared vocabulary in testdata/occasions/family-function.json and testdata/api/look.json give them. The shown jhumkas and their gold are true of the recording's render and of the result shown here, which is why one check can stand beside the other picture; the picture a judge sees is the YouCam one. A discarded pass carries no check values, because none was recorded for it.
